data.name: Arlina
data.gender_notes: Arlina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arlina is derived from the Greek name Arline, which is a feminine form of the masculine name Arnold. Arnold comes from the Old German name Arnold, which is composed of the elements arn, meaning 'eagle,' and wald, meaning 'ruler.' In the context of Arlina, the name evokes the image of a noble and powerful woman, a ruler with the strength and grace of an eagle.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength, courage, and exalted status.
data.etymology: Arlina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honor, exalted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arlina total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: עֲרָלִינָ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עֲרָלִינָ, (Arlina) - משמעות השם, חברה, נקבה, חבר, נקבה. השם עֲרָלִין, (Arlin) - עץ הארל, עצי ארל. השם הוא עברי, מקורו בעברית, נפוץ בקרב יהודים. בספר תהלים (118:8), (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:19), (Shir HaShirim 3:10), (Song of Solomon 3:10) - 'עֲרָלִין', (Arlin), 'עֲרָלִינָ', (Arlina).

in_greek.name: Άρλίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Άρλίνα, (Arlina) - σημασία του ονόματος, κορασιά, θυγάτηρ, κόρη. το όνομα Άρλιν, (Arlin) - δέντρο Άρλιανο, δέντρα Άρλιανα. το όνομα είναι ελληνικό, καταγωγή από την ελληνική, κοινώς χρησιμοποιείται στις ελληνικές κοινότητες. στην Καινή Διαθήκη, (New Testament), (Matthew 1:25), (Matthew 2:16) - 'Άρλιν', (Arlin), 'Άρλίνα', (Arlina).

in_latin.name: Arlina
in_latin.long_meaning: Arlina - significatio nominis, puella, filia, femina. Nomen Arlin - arbor Arlia, arbores Arliana. Nomen est latino, origo a Latina, frequentius in Ecclesia Latina usatur. In Biblia, (Bible), (Genesis 1:1), (Genesis 3:20) - 'Arlin', (Arlin), 'Arlina', (Arlina).

in_english.name: Arlina
in_english.long_meaning: Arlina - meaning of name, girl, daughter, maiden. The name Arlin - Arlia tree, Arlian trees. The name is of Latin origin, frequent in Christian tradition. In the Bible, (Genesis 1:1), (Genesis 3:20) - 'Arlin', (Arlin), 'Arlina', (Arlina). Arlina is also derived from the Hebrew name 'Arlin', (Arlin) meaning 'noble' or 'exalted'.
